name: Inkling-2-Mini UD-IQ4_XS — own Xe runtime, one B70 (Plain & DSpark)

library.variant: UD-IQ4_XS quantized weights (+ optional lossless DSpark Q8_0 drafter)
library.summary: One B70 (32 GiB): cold uncached 12-prompt realistic suite (512-token cap, cached_tokens=0) reaches 92.77–92.80 tok/s plain and 121.87–124.79 tok/s with lossless DSpark (12/12 prompts bit-identical across all 4 fresh servers; 0 GPU faults). Direct CLI reaches 93.08 tok/s plain / 150.55 tok/s DSpark / 160.7 tok/s 4-seq; 6-card 1M needle reaches 891.6 tok/s prompt / 68.59 tok/s decode.
library.benchmark_status: Four fresh OpenAI-compatible servers passed realistic_final_gate (cached_tokens=0, 512-token cap, 12/12 bit-identical Plain==DSpark): 92.77–92.80 tok/s plain and 121.87–124.79 tok/s DSpark (1–100 class-balanced median). Clean-host OS replay and external publication attestation remain pending.

hardware.note: Fits entirely on one 32 GiB Intel Arc Pro B70 (27.1 GiB VRAM plain / 27.9 GiB VRAM with DSpark at 64K context) on a 15 GiB host; scales to 2–6 cards and 1M context via host-staged pipeline split and shared KV.

runtime.engine: Own Xe2 SYCL/ESIMD/XMX runtime (ink_run); strict IEEE -fp-model=precise -ffp-contract=off
runtime.note: Bit-exact against baseline v8 across all 15/15 check-exact.sh gates (426/426 tensor dumps, DSpark, 4-seq, vision) with lossless F32_HI16 certification, NVFP4 SOA tiles, fused moe_route_group, and XWoQ8+attn_tail.

project_patches.note: Standalone C++/SYCL/ESIMD runtime in experiments/own-xpu-runtime/inkling2/; no external runtime patch overlay required.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Standalone Xe2 SYCL/ESIMD/XMX inference engine, exact BF16-split DPAS, lossless F32_HI16 certification, NVFP4 SOA packing, fused moe_route_group, XWoQ8+attn_tail, DSpark speculative decoding, and OpenAI-compatible HTTP server.
contributors.validated_effect: Four fresh OpenAI-compatible servers passed realistic_final_gate (cached_tokens=0, 512-token cap, 0 GPU faults): 92.77–92.80 tok/s plain and 121.87–124.79 tok/s DSpark with 12/12 prompts (6,144 tokens) 100% bit-identical across all 4 servers.

text_measurements.scope: Four fresh OpenAI-compatible servers on one B70 each (2 plain, 2 DSpark INK_SPEC=7) at 64K context with INK_SERVE_SNAP=0 and empty cache library (cached_tokens=0 on every row). Decode is the class-balanced median over the first 99 intervals (tokens 1–100) across the fixed 12-prompt realistic suite (--return-token-ids --require-natural-eos --max-tokens 512). Reading row is a distinct uncached 931-input-token request on Batch 1 servers.
